description: Use this to see which employers are hiring. Returns employers with their live role counts, most roles first. Accepts the same filters as search_jobs, so it answers 'who is hiring quant developers in Bengaluru' directly.

category.description: Taxonomy path prefix, e.g. 'engineering/software' - matches that node and everything under it.

city.description: City name. Matched as a substring with synonyms, so 'bangalore' also finds 'Bengaluru'.

company.description: Employer name, case-insensitive. Comma-separated for several.

employment_type.description: Employment type - the exact id, with underscores (full_time, part_time).

location_scope.description: Country bucket, lowercase: india, us, uk, sg, or a lowercase ISO country code for anywhere else (de, ca, jp, ...); also remote, multiple, unspecified. India is 'india' (not 'in') and the UK is 'uk' (not 'gb'). There is no 'eu' bucket.

q.description: Text to match in the job title or company name.

seen_after.description: ISO date. Only roles confirmed live on or after this date.

tech.description: A technology named in the stack, e.g. kubernetes. Comma-separated for several.

visa.description: stated (the posting says it sponsors), likely (stated or inferred), or refused.

name: list_companies
title: List hiring employers
